tha-ap378:1.1: Citesu kiramānesu nānāgandhe samāgate / pasannacitto sumano gandhamuṭṭhim apūjayiṃ. // //
tha-ap378:2.1: Satasahasse ito kappe citakaṃ yam apūjayiṃ / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi citapūjāy' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap378:3.1: Sāgataṃ vata me āsi mama Buddhassa santike /
tha-ap378:4.1: tisso vijjā anuppatto kataṃ Buddhassa sāsanaṃ.
tha-ap378:7.1: Gandhamuṭṭhiyo th. i. g. a-ti. Gandhamuṭṭhiyattherassa
